title: Travel
description: Get from one place to another and ask for help doing it.

questions.sentence: Aap kahan jaa rahe hain?
options: Main station jaa raha hoon.
Main ghar par hoon.
Yeh meri bus hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main station jaa raha hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I am going to the station.

questions.sentence: Yeh bus station jaati hai.
options: This bus goes to the station.
This bus comes from the station.
This train goes to the station.
questions.correctAnswer: This bus goes to the station.

questions.sentence: Aapki train kab hai?
options: Meri train subah hai.
Mera ghar bahut door hai.
Main bus se jaata hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Meri train subah hai.
questions.translatedSentence: My train is in the morning.

questions.sentence: Main abhi Dilli jaa raha hoon.
options: I am going to Delhi right now.
I am coming from Delhi right now.
I live in Delhi right now.
questions.correctAnswer: I am going to Delhi right now.

questions.sentence: Station kahan hai?
options: Station yahan se paas hai.
Station bahut bada hai.
Station subah khulta hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Station yahan se paas hai.
questions.translatedSentence: The station is near here.

questions.sentence: Meri bus abhi aa rahi hai.
options: My bus is coming now.
My bus has already gone.
My bus is very slow.
questions.correctAnswer: My bus is coming now.

questions.sentence: Kya aap train se jaa rahe hain?
options: Nahi, main bus se jaa raha hoon.
Haan, main ghar par hoon.
Nahi, mujhe chai chahiye.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahi, main bus se jaa raha hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I am going by bus.

questions.sentence: Train station bahut door nahi hai.
options: The train station is not very far.
The train station is very far.
The train is not very fast.
questions.correctAnswer: The train station is not very far.

questions.sentence: Tum kahan jaa rahe ho?
options: Main bazaar jaa raha hoon.
Main theek hoon.
Yeh mera dost hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main bazaar jaa raha hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I am going to the market.

questions.sentence: Aapko kitne ticket chahiye?
options: Mujhe do ticket chahiye.
Mujhe ek station chahiye.
Mujhe yeh train pasand hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Mujhe do ticket chahiye.
questions.translatedSentence: I need two tickets.

questions.sentence: Jaipur ka ek ticket kitne ka hai?
options: How much is one ticket to Jaipur?
How many tickets to Jaipur are left?
When is the train to Jaipur?
questions.correctAnswer: How much is one ticket to Jaipur?

questions.sentence: Agli train kitne baje hai?
options: Agli train do baje hai.
Agli train bahut lambi hai.
Agli train Jaipur ki hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Agli train do baje hai.
questions.translatedSentence: The next train is at two o'clock.

questions.sentence: Mujhe Lucknow ke do ticket chahiye.
options: I need two tickets to Lucknow.
I need two tickets from Lucknow.
I bought two tickets to Lucknow.
questions.correctAnswer: I need two tickets to Lucknow.

questions.sentence: Kya yeh train Lucknow jaati hai?
options: Haan, yeh train Lucknow jaati hai.
Nahi, yeh ticket bahut mahanga hai.
Haan, mujhe ek ticket chahiye.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, yeh train Lucknow jaati hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, this train goes to Lucknow.

questions.sentence: Ticket ki line bahut lambi hai.
options: The ticket queue is very long.
The ticket is very expensive.
The ticket counter is very far.
questions.correctAnswer: The ticket queue is very long.

questions.sentence: Aap kis platform se jaa rahe hain?
options: Main platform teen se jaa raha hoon.
Main do ticket le raha hoon.
Main subah Jaipur jaa raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Main platform teen se jaa raha hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I am leaving from platform three.

questions.sentence: Yeh ticket sirf aaj ke liye hai.
options: This ticket is only for today.
This ticket is only for the morning.
This ticket is for tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: This ticket is only for today.

questions.sentence: Kya ticket abhi mil sakta hai?
options: Haan, ticket khidki par mil jaayega.
Nahi, yeh train bahut lambi hai.
Haan, station yahan se paas hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, ticket khidki par mil jaayega.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, you will get the ticket at the counter.

questions.sentence: Bazaar kaise jaate hain?
options: Seedhe jaayiye, phir daayein mudiye.
Bazaar mein sab kuch mahanga hai.
Mujhe is bazaar ki chai pasand hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Seedhe jaayiye, phir daayein mudiye.
questions.translatedSentence: Go straight, then turn right.

questions.sentence: Metro station yahan se kitna door hai?
options: How far is the metro station from here?
How do I get to the metro station from here?
Which metro station is this?
questions.correctAnswer: How far is the metro station from here?

questions.sentence: Kya yahan paas mein koi bank hai?
options: Haan, agle mod par ek bank hai.
Nahi, yeh bank bahut bada hai.
Haan, mujhe thode paise chahiye.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, agle mod par ek bank hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, there is a bank at the next turn.

questions.sentence: Baayein mudiye, hospital saamne hai.
options: Turn left, the hospital is straight ahead.
Turn right, the hospital is behind you.
Go straight, the hospital is still far.
questions.correctAnswer: Turn left, the hospital is straight ahead.

questions.sentence: Kya main wahan paidal jaa sakta hoon?
options: Haan, sirf paanch minute lagenge.
Haan, mujhe yeh raasta pasand hai.
Nahi, mera ghar yahin paas hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, sirf paanch minute lagenge.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, it will take only five minutes.

questions.sentence: Mujhe yeh raasta bilkul pata nahi hai.
options: I do not know this road at all.
I know this road very well.
This road is not very long.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not know this road at all.

questions.sentence: Maaf kijiye, purana bazaar kis taraf hai?
options: Woh is sadak ki doosri taraf hai.
Woh bazaar bahut purana hai.
Main us bazaar mein kaam karta hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Woh is sadak ki doosri taraf hai.
questions.translatedSentence: It is on the other side of this road.

questions.sentence: Auto stand chowk ke bilkul paas hai.
options: The auto stand is right next to the crossing.
The auto stand is quite far from the crossing.
The bus stand is right next to the crossing.
questions.correctAnswer: The auto stand is right next to the crossing.

questions.sentence: Kya yeh sadak station tak jaati hai?
options: Haan, yeh sadak seedhe station tak jaati hai.
Nahi, yeh sadak bahut chhoti hai.
Haan, station par bahut bheed hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, yeh sadak seedhe station tak jaati hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, this road goes straight to the station.

questions.sentence: Bhaiya, station ke kitne loge?
options: Do sau rupaye lagenge.
Mujhe bhi station jaana hai.
Station yahan se bahut door hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Do sau rupaye lagenge.
questions.translatedSentence: It will cost two hundred rupees.

questions.sentence: Kya aap meter se chalenge?
options: Will you go by the meter?
Will you take me to the meter?
Is your meter working?
questions.correctAnswer: Will you go by the meter?

questions.sentence: Meter se chaloge na?
options: Haan, meter se hi chalenge.
Nahi, yeh auto mera nahi hai.
Haan, mujhe ek auto chahiye.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, meter se hi chalenge.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, we will go by the meter only.

questions.sentence: Yahan rok dijiye, main yahin utar jaaunga.
options: Stop here, I will get off right here.
Stop here, I will wait right here.
Keep going, I will get off later.
questions.correctAnswer: Stop here, I will get off right here.

questions.sentence: Kitna kiraya hua?
options: Sau rupaye hue.
Do kilometre hue.
Bahut der ho gayi.
questions.correctAnswer: Sau rupaye hue.
questions.translatedSentence: It came to one hundred rupees.

questions.sentence: Auto wale ne bahut zyada paise maange.
options: The auto driver asked for far too much money.
The auto driver gave the money back.
The auto driver did not take any money.
questions.correctAnswer: The auto driver asked for far too much money.

questions.sentence: Aage chowk par rok dena.
options: Theek hai, wahin rok dunga.
Theek hai, kiraya sau rupaye hai.
Nahi, mera meter kharab hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Theek hai, wahin rok dunga.
questions.translatedSentence: Alright, I will stop right there.

questions.sentence: Meter kharab hai, isliye main sau rupaye lunga.
options: The meter is broken, so I will take one hundred rupees.
The meter is working, so I will take one hundred rupees.
The meter is broken, but I will not take any money.
questions.correctAnswer: The meter is broken, so I will take one hundred rupees.

questions.sentence: Kya aap thoda kam kar sakte hain?
options: Theek hai, bees rupaye kam kar dunga.
Haan, aap meter se chaliye.
Nahi, main auto nahi chalata.
questions.correctAnswer: Theek hai, bees rupaye kam kar dunga.
questions.translatedSentence: Alright, I will take twenty rupees off.

questions.sentence: Kya ek kamra khaali hai?
options: Haan, do kamre khaali hain.
Nahi, yeh kamra bahut bada hai.
Haan, mujhe yeh kamra pasand hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, do kamre khaali hain.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, two rooms are free.

questions.sentence: Ek raat ka kiraya kitna hai?
options: How much does one night cost?
How many nights will you stay?
How much did you pay last night?
questions.correctAnswer: How much does one night cost?

questions.sentence: Aap kitne din rukenge?
options: Main teen din rukunga.
Main teen baje aaunga.
Main teesri manzil par rukunga.
questions.correctAnswer: Main teen din rukunga.
questions.translatedSentence: I will stay for three days.

questions.sentence: Kamre mein garam paani aata hai.
options: There is hot water in the room.
There is no hot water in the room.
The room gets very hot in the day.
questions.correctAnswer: There is hot water in the room.

questions.sentence: Kya kamre mein khidki hai?
options: Haan, khidki bazaar ki taraf khulti hai.
Nahi, kamra teesri manzil par hai.
Haan, kamra bahut saaf hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, khidki bazaar ki taraf khulti hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, the window opens towards the market.

questions.sentence: Mera kamra teesri manzil par hai.
options: My room is on the third floor.
My room is the third one on this floor.
There are three rooms on my floor.
questions.correctAnswer: My room is on the third floor.

questions.sentence: Naashta kitne baje milta hai?
options: Naashta subah aath baje milta hai.
Naashta kamre mein nahi milta.
Naashte ke saath chai bhi milti hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Naashta subah aath baje milta hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Breakfast is served at eight in the morning.

questions.sentence: Agar yeh kamra pasand nahi aaya to main doosra le lunga.
options: If I do not like this room, I will take another one.
I liked this room, so I will take another one too.
If this room is not free, I will come back tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: If I do not like this room, I will take another one.

questions.sentence: Kya main kamra abhi dekh sakta hoon?
options: Haan, chaliye, main aapko dikhata hoon.
Nahi, naashta aath baje milta hai.
Haan, ek raat ka kiraya sau rupaye hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, chaliye, main aapko dikhata hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, come along, I will show you.

questions.sentence: Train itni der se kyun aa rahi hai?
options: Baarish ki wajah se train do ghante late hai.
Train platform teen par khadi hai.
Main is train se Jaipur jaa raha hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Baarish ki wajah se train do ghante late hai.
questions.translatedSentence: The train is two hours late because of the rain.

questions.sentence: Mera bag bus mein hi reh gaya.
options: My bag got left behind in the bus.
My bag is here in the bus with me.
I took my bag out of the bus.
questions.correctAnswer: My bag got left behind in the bus.

questions.sentence: Aapka saamaan kaisa dikhta hai?
options: Woh kaala bag hai jis par mera naam likha hai.
Mera saamaan zyada bhaari nahi hai.
Main apna saamaan platform par chhod aaya.
questions.correctAnswer: Woh kaala bag hai jis par mera naam likha hai.
questions.translatedSentence: It is a black bag with my name written on it.

questions.sentence: Agar train aur late hui to main bus se chala jaaunga.
options: If the train gets any later, I will just go by bus.
If the train comes on time, I will go by bus instead.
The train is late, but I will still wait for it.
questions.correctAnswer: If the train gets any later, I will just go by bus.

questions.sentence: Kya aap meri thodi madad kar sakte hain?
options: Haan, boliye, main kya kar sakta hoon?
Nahi, mujhe bhi madad chahiye thi.
Haan, meri train do baje hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, boliye, main kya kar sakta hoon?
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, tell me, what can I do?

questions.sentence: Mujhe kuch samajh nahi aa raha, isliye main pooch raha hoon.
options: I do not understand any of this, so I am asking.
I understand all of this, so I am not asking.
I could not hear you, so I am asking again.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not understand any of this, so I am asking.

questions.sentence: Aapne apna bag kahan rakha tha?
options: Maine use ticket khidki ke paas rakha tha.
Maine apna ticket kal khareeda tha.
Mera bag bahut purana ho gaya hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Maine use ticket khidki ke paas rakha tha.
questions.translatedSentence: I had kept it near the ticket counter.

questions.sentence: Maafi chahta hoon, lekin mujhe abhi nikalna hoga.
options: I am sorry, but I have to leave right now.
I am sorry, but I cannot come tomorrow.
Excuse me, but I have only just arrived.
questions.correctAnswer: I am sorry, but I have to leave right now.

questions.sentence: Apna phone number likha dijiye, taaki bag milne par hum aapko bata sakein.
options: Haan zaroor, main abhi likh deta hoon.
Nahi, mera bag kaale rang ka hai.
Haan, meri train do ghante late hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan zaroor, main abhi likh deta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes of course, I will write it down right now.
